# Digital Technology Partner

> Digital Technology Partner (DTP) helps leadership teams turn scattered AI activity into governed systems with measurable operational value.

DTP publishes information about its AI programmes, practical systems, evidence-gated delivery process, anonymised case-study patterns, and commentary on AI adoption, governance and delivery.

## Start here

- [Home](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/home/): DTP's main overview and routes into readiness, leadership support and delivery.
- [Why DTP](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/why-dtp/): How DTP approaches governance, stage-gated delivery and partner evaluation.
- [Solutions](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/solutions/): Dashboards, automation, AI agents and bespoke systems chosen after the work is understood.
- [Process](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/process/): Discover, Prove, Build, Pilot and Launch, with evidence and the right to stop at each gate.
- [Contact](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/contact/): Public contact routes and what happens after an enquiry.

## Programmes

- [AI programmes](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/): Readiness, AI Foundry and leadership coaching.
- [AI Adoption Readiness](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-adoption-readiness/): A one-week assessment of current AI use, risk, opportunity and next decisions.
- [AI Foundry](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-foundry/): A twelve-week working group that turns experiments into evidence and leadership choices.
- [Leadership AI Coaching](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/leadership-ai-coaching/): Private AI coaching for senior leaders.

## Evidence and commentary

- [Case studies](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/case-studies/): Four anonymised patterns from real operations.
- [Insights](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/insights/): Commentary on AI adoption, governance, delivery and leadership decisions.
- [Newsroom](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/news/): Public articles on AI adoption, governance, delivery and automation.

## More detail

- [Full public-page guide](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/llms-full.txt): A fuller, factual index of the approved public pages.
